title: Earliest known writing at Uruk (proto-cuneiform)
summary: The first unequivocal written documents appear at Uruk. Most are accounting records.
why: Writing let people store information outside memory: the start of recorded history.

notes.problem: 'Writing invented at Uruk' exceeds source ('first unequivocal written documents'); Egyptian origin left open ('no definitive determination').

superlativeSource: The first unequivocal written documents start with the Uruk IV period
